blocks.text: OFFERING THE THERAPY YOUR EQUINE PARTNER DESERVES!

blocks.html: We specialize in the care, recovery, and training of performance horses. Our new service line will focus on hydrotherapy, using a water treadmill and salt water spa to help horses recover from injuries, maintain fitness during layups, and enhance performance.

items.title: ECB AQUA TREADMILL
items.html:
The ECB equine aqua treadmill is an effective tool for horse training and rehabilitation. Installed with the latest technology and performance analysis, the user-friendly system allows for the creation and storage of individual programs for the training and rehabilitation of each horse.

The equine water treadmill is made with high-quality materials, has numerous safety features, and allows for the use of both fresh and salt water. The full benefits of horse hydrotherapy can be achieved in a safe and simple way.

items.title: RED LIGHT THERAPY
items.html:
RED LIGHT therapy supports healing and recovery. It works by delivering specific wavelengths of red or near-infrared light that penetrate the skin and stimulate cellular activity.

Key benefits for horses:

  • Supports skin and coat health, aiding wound repair and reducing swelling
  • Reduces inflammation and pain in muscles, joints, and tendons
  • Speeds up healing of soft tissue injuries, wounds, and strains
  • Improves circulation, bringing more oxygen and nutrients to tissues
  • Promotes muscle relaxation and helps recovery after exercise

items.title: EQUIVIBE
items.html:
EQUIVIBE 4080 benefits:

  • Improves lymphatic and blood circulation.
  • Reduces muscle soreness and inflammation
  • Provides true vertical vibration, which mimics natural movement.
  • Increases bone density and stimulates hoof growth.

What Can We Do for You?

blocks.html: We provide customized programs designed to improve soundness, enhance performance, and support long-term equine health. Whether your horse is coming back from injury or maintaining peak condition, our goal is to deliver structured, results-driven care tailored to each individual horse.

Don't just take our word for it! Listen to what others are saying about the AW Equine Rehab therapies offered. Real horsemen sharing their experiences and triumphs in rehabilitation and injury prevention.

Keep your horse feeling its best so it can use its body correctly and without compensation for pain or inflammation. A comfortable horse is a great working athlete.

pages.title: About
pages.metaDescription: The story behind Walstrom Equine Therapy & Conditioning, from Ashley Walstrom.

hero.title: Our Why
hero.subtitle: Let me tell you what led me to create Walstrom Equine Therapy & Conditioning.

blocks.html:
If there’s one thing that has shaped my life, it’s horses.

For over 10 years, I’ve been immersed in the performance horse world — riding, training, and learning what it truly takes to develop horses that can compete at a high level. Along the way, I started to notice a pattern… even the most talented horses can only go as far as their bodies allow them.

I’ve worked with horses that had all the heart and ability in the world, but were held back by soreness, setbacks, or simply not having the right kind of history behind them to support them. And I’ve also seen what happens when a horse feels good — they move differently, they try harder, and everything just comes together.

That’s what led me to create Walstrom Equine Therapy & Conditioning.

This isn’t just about having the right equipment. It’s about understanding the horse in front of you — how they move, what they need, and how to help them improve in a way that supports their long-term soundness and performance.

Through services like aqua treadmill conditioning and cold saltwater therapy, I work with horses in all stages — whether they’re coming back from an injury, needing a reset, or simply looking to stay competitive and strong throughout their season.

My goal is simple:

To help horses feel and perform at their absolute best.

Because at the end of the day, these horses give us everything they have.

If you’re looking to help your horse recover, build strength, or stay competitive longer — I’d love to be a part of your team.

— Ashley Walstrom
Walstrom Equine Therapy & Conditioning
